from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its case type and relevant crimes/causes of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_type: Literal["刑事", "行政", "民事"] | None = Field(description="Whether this is criminal, administrative, or civil")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court name if mentioned")
    crimes_or_causes: list[str] = Field(description="All crimes, charges, or cause of action mentioned/recognized in this document")
    is_dushui_crime_confirmed: bool | None = Field(description="Whether 渎职罪 or variants like 滥用职权 is explicitly confirmed as a criminal charge in this document")
    relevant_facts: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of relevant facts regarding 渎职罪 or related issues, if any")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
